question:
Let \(f(x)=x^2(1-x)^2.\) What is the value of the sum

\[ \begin{gathered} f\!\left(\tfrac{1}{2019}\right)-f\!\left(\tfrac{2}{2019}\right) \\ {}+f\!\left(\tfrac{3}{2019}\right)-f\!\left(\tfrac{4}{2019}\right) \\ {}+\cdots+f\!\left(\tfrac{2017}{2019}\right) \\ {}-f\!\left(\tfrac{2018}{2019}\right)? \end{gathered} \]
solution:
Inputs that add to \(1\) give equal function values, allowing terms from opposite ends of the sum to cancel. Indeed,
\[
f(1-x)=(1-x)^2x^2=f(x).
\]
Pair the terms with indices \(k\) and \(2019-k\), for \(k=1,2,\ldots,1009\). Their inputs add to \(1\), so
\[
f\!\left(\frac{k}{2019}\right)
=
f\!\left(\frac{2019-k}{2019}\right).
\]
Their indices add to the odd number \(2019\), so one index is odd and the other is even. In the given sum, odd-indexed terms are added and even-indexed terms are subtracted. Thus each pair contributes zero.

These \(1009\) pairs use every index from \(1\) through \(2018\) exactly once. Therefore the sum is \(\boxed{0}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
